mainEntity.name: Are hyperliquid fees cheaper than a centralized futures exchange?

acceptedAnswer.text: You cannot decide from a headline taker fee alone. Hyperliquid fees depend on a maker/taker fee tier based on rolling 14-day volume, separate spot and perp schedules, sub-account volume rules, vault-volume separation, HIP-3 market conditions and referral discount eligibility; hourly peer-to-peer funding is separate from maker/taker trading fees and can change the holding cost.

mainEntity.name: Does Hyperliquid have cashback or a referral discount?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use official referral language, not a generic cashback promise. A hyperliquid cashback search should be checked against official referral discount and reward terms: Hyperliquid's docs describe referral rewards and a referral-code fee discount with volume boundaries; they also say referral discounts do not apply to vaults or sub-accounts. Verify the current app state before treating any code or link as a live benefit.

mainEntity.name: How should I read Hyperliquid funding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hyperliquid describes funding as peer-to-peer and paid every hour. A position can pay or receive funding depending on the premium and interest components, so it belongs in the pre-trade checklist rather than after-the-fact reporting.

mainEntity.name: What is the liquidation check on Hyperliquid?

acceptedAnswer.text: Check account equity against maintenance margin before relying on leverage. Hyperliquid states liquidation begins when equity falls below maintenance margin, and that maintenance margin varies by asset and maximum leverage.

mainEntity.name: Does Hyperliquid offer a funded account?

acceptedAnswer.text: Treat hyperliquid funded account keywords as a separate research path. Official Hyperliquid docs can support checks around self-funded wallet collateral, vault participation, sub-accounts and API-wallet signing routes, but they do not prove third-party trader-funding offers, a third-party capital allocation offer or a promised trader-funding result.
